Clara: Heads-up: our SDK error surface is confusing; apps either spam retries or show raw errors. Can we standardize a minimal contract that also includes an `action` enum e.g. `retry`, `reauth`, `fix_input`, `contact_support`?

Devon: I like `action`. Also add `displayable` boolean to indicate safe-to-show to end users. Servers sometimes dump stacks into `message` so `displayable=false` helps clients avoid leaking internals.

Ibrahim: Mapping proposal (concise): 401 -> action=reauth + code=auth_expired, 429 -> action=retry + retry_after, 400 -> action=fix_input + field_hint/remediation, 403 (policy) -> action=contact_support, 5xx -> action=retry but `displayable=false`. Add `ops_id` for support lookups.

Noah: Small parity note: arrays like `fields` can be annoying in Go SDKs and small clients. Prefer `field_hint` (short string) and a `copy_key` so the sampleapp can look up localized text. Also include `remediation` (one-liner) for UX.

Clara: Sampleapp wiring idea: map `action` to specific UI affordances (button text, countdown, form focus). If `displayable` is false, show a generic friendly message and include `ops_id` to share with support.

Devon: For JS: expose `err.action`, `err.displayable`, `err.remediation`, `err.retry_after`, `err.code`, `err.ops_id`. For Go: export typed errors with methods Action(), Displayable(), Remediation(), RetryAfter(), Code(), OpsID(). Add unit tests asserting these exist.

Ibrahim: Example envelope for clarity: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "action": "retry",
    "displayable": true,
    "retry_after": 14,
    "remediation": "Try again after the countdown; batch requests if possible",
    "ops_id": "ops-2026-07",
    "copy_key": "rate_limit.wait"
  }
}
```

Noah: Also recommend a short `signal` or `telemetry_key` for Console grouping (e.g. `quota_exceeded`, `policy_block`) so product can surface recommended remediation automatically.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-912: "error contract: action/displayable/remediation + sampleapp" and linked this thread.

Clara: Great thread. Next steps: lock the JSON contract, add copybank entries keyed by `copy_key`, and land JS + Go parity PRs. I'll pick up the copybank work and a tiny sampleapp patch. Meeting in 15 to finalize wording. :thumbsup:
